issues.issue: The line's own review note says rents/fees (1,710, p10) are the dominant part and licenses are only 975. The mixed-line rule says to use the dominant category, which would be Rentals or charges for services, not licenses and permits.
This mixed line is coded as benefits here, but the same label in the governmental detail is coded salaries and wages. Salaries are probably the dominant part, so the two codings are inconsistent.
The Ambulance department's charges are ambulance fees. The rules have specific categories for these: detail 'ambulance/rescue fees' and receipt category Ambulance Fees.
Pool department charges fit the specific category 'recreation/pool/park fees' (Recreation Fees).
Cemetery department charges fit the specific category 'cemetery fees'.
